single.sql:
SELECT barrier, block_size, blocks, cluster_size, clusters, ns_per_barrier
FROM barrier
single.transformScript:
# One bar per level of the GPU, at a representative configuration: the
# median over the repetitions of that job.
import pandas as pd
df = df.groupby(['barrier', 'block_size', 'blocks', 'cluster_size', 'clusters'],
                as_index=False)['ns_per_barrier'].median()
picks = [  # (barrier, which job, label, colour)
    ('syncthreads', 'block_size == 128', '__syncthreads(), 128 threads', '#2ca02c'),
    ('syncthreads', 'block_size == 1024', '__syncthreads(), 1024 threads', '#2ca02c'),
    ('cluster-relaxed', 'cluster_size == 12 and clusters == 1',
     'cluster, relaxed arrive, 12 blocks', '#17becf'),
    ('cluster', 'cluster_size == 12 and clusters == 1', 'cluster.sync(), 12 blocks', '#1f77b4'),
    ('grid', 'blocks == 48', 'grid.sync(), 48 blocks (1 per SM)', '#d62728'),
]
rows = []
for barrier, which, label, color in picks:
    match = df[df['barrier'] == barrier].query(which)
    if len(match):
        rows.append({'barrier': label, 'ns_per_barrier': match['ns_per_barrier'].iloc[0],
                     'color': color})
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

# a2av.cu figure, in the house style of dgx-spark/latency/plot/plotstyle.py.
import matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.ticker import FixedLocator, FormatStrFormatter, NullFormatter, NullLocator
HOUSE = {
    "font.size": 16, "axes.titlesize": 17, "axes.labelsize": 16,
    "xtick.labelsize": 13, "ytick.labelsize": 13, "legend.fontsize": 13,
    "legend.title_fontsize": 13, "figure.titlesize": 18,
    "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.grid": True, "grid.alpha": 0.3, "lines.linewidth": 2.2, "lines.markersize": 6,
}
# DSMEM methods in blues/purple, global-memory methods in oranges/red.
METHODS = {
    "dsmem-push": ("#1f77b4", "o"), "dsmem-pull": ("#17becf", "o"), "dsmem-bulk": ("#9467bd", "o"),
    "gmem-ldst": ("#ff7f0e", "s"), "gmem-tma": ("#d62728", "s"),
}
DISTRIBUTIONS = ["UNIMODALFLAT", "UNIMODALPEAK", "MONOTONEDECAY", "HEAVYTAIL"]


def start(fig, size):
    """Throw away the default rendering and start a clean figure in the house style."""
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(*size)


def message_size_axis(ax, sizes):
    """log2 x axis labelled with the message sizes that were run."""
    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(sizes))
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{s}" if s < 1024 else f"{s // 1024} Ki" for s in sizes])


def panels(fig, distributions, rows, cols):
    """One axes per distribution present in the data, sharing both axes."""
    axes = fig.subplots(rows, cols, sharex=True, sharey=True, squeeze=False).ravel()
    for ax in axes[len(distributions):]:
        ax.set_visible(False)
    return list(zip(axes, distributions))


def one_legend(fig, axes):
    """A single legend above the panels instead of one per panel."""
    handles, labels = {}, {}
    for ax in axes:
        for h, l in zip(*ax.get_legend_handles_labels()):
            handles.setdefault(l, h)
    fig.legend(handles.values(), handles.keys(), loc="outside upper center",
               ncol=len(handles), frameon=False)

def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (11, 5))
    ax = fig.add_subplot()
    d = df.iloc[::-1]   # first entry on top
    bars = ax.barh(d["barrier"], d["ns_per_barrier"], color=d["color"], height=0.6)
    for b, v in zip(bars, d["ns_per_barrier"]):
        ax.text(v, b.get_y() + b.get_height() / 2, f"  {v:.0f} ns", va="center", fontsize=14)
    ax.set_xlim(0, d["ns_per_barrier"].max() * 1.2)
    ax.set_xlabel("time per barrier (ns)")
    ax.grid(True, axis="x", alpha=0.3)
    ax.grid(False, axis="y")
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)

    "dsmem-push": ("#1f77b4", "o"), "dsmem-pull": ("#17becf", "o"), "dsmem-bulk": ("#9467bd", "o"),

}
DISTRIBUTIONS = ["UNIMODALFLAT", "UNIMODALPEAK", "MONOTONEDECAY", "HEAVYTAIL"]


def start(fig, size):
    """Throw away the default rendering and start a clean figure in the house style."""
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(*size)

    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(sizes))
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{s}" if s < 1024 else f"{s // 1024} Ki" for s in sizes])


def panels(fig, distributions, rows, cols):
    """One axes per distribution present in the data, sharing both axes."""

    for ax in axes[len(distributions):]:
        ax.set_visible(False)
    return list(zip(axes, distributions))


def one_legend(fig, axes):
    """A single legend above the panels instead of one per panel."""
    handles, labels = {}, {}
    for ax in axes:
        for h, l in zip(*ax.get_legend_handles_labels()):
            handles.setdefault(l, h)
    fig.legend(handles.values(), handles.keys(), loc="outside upper center",
               ncol=len(handles), frameon=False)

def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (17, 5.4))
    block, cluster, grid = fig.subplots(1, 3)

    d = df[df["barrier"] == "syncthreads"].sort_values("block_size")
    block.plot(d["block_size"], d["ns_per_barrier"], marker="o", color="#2ca02c")
    block.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    block.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(d["block_size"].tolist()))
    block.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
    block.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FormatStrFormatter("%d"))
    block.set_xlabel("threads per block")
    block.set_title("__syncthreads()")

    for name, color in (("cluster", "#1f77b4"), ("cluster-relaxed", "#17becf")):
        d = df[df["barrier"] == name]
        alone = d[d["clusters"] == 1].sort_values("cluster_size")
        full = d[d["clusters"] > 1].sort_values("cluster_size")
        label = "cluster.sync()" if name == "cluster" else "relaxed arrive"
        cluster.plot(alone["cluster_size"], alone["ns_per_barrier"], marker="o", color=color,
                     label=f"{label}, 1 cluster")
        cluster.plot(full["cluster_size"], full["ns_per_barrier"], marker="s", color=color,
                     linestyle="--", label=f"{label}, chip full")
    sizes = sorted(df.loc[df["barrier"] == "cluster", "cluster_size"].unique())
    cluster.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(sizes))
    cluster.set_ylim(0, None)
    cluster.set_xlabel("blocks per cluster")
    cluster.set_title("cluster barrier")
    cluster.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=11)

    d = df[df["barrier"] == "grid"].sort_values("blocks")
    grid.plot(d["blocks"], d["ns_per_barrier"], marker="o", color="#d62728")
    grid.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    grid.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(d["blocks"].tolist()))
    grid.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
    grid.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FormatStrFormatter("%d"))
    grid.set_ylim(0, None)
    grid.set_xlabel("blocks in the grid")
    grid.set_title("grid.sync()")

    block.set_ylim(0, None)
    block.set_ylabel("time per barrier (ns)")
